title: Shedding Bones - Hostile
description: Hostile mobs occasionally drop their bones on death
body:
**Sheeding Bones - Hostile version**


Hostile Mobs now drop bones when killed. Zombie, Creeper, Enderman, Ghast, Witch, Wither Skeleton, Husk, Vindicato, Pillager, Evoker, Ravager, Guardian, Elder Guardian and Drowned have a balanced chance to drop 0-2 bones that scales with Looting. Works with vanilla farms.

Mobs like Spiders do NOT drops bones, Spiders don't have bones, silly! :)



Simple loot table mod, no config needed.
- Chance for realistic bone drops from Hostile Mobs
- No performance impact



Perfect for peaceful playthroughs!
